evals.prompt: Who calls processPayment in this codebase? Trace the call chain.
evals.expected_output: Uses the knowledge graph trace_path inbound after confirming the project is indexed.
assertions: Checks list_projects and indexes the repo if needed (index_repository then index_status)
Uses trace_path with direction inbound for callers
Does not fall back to wide Grep sweeps for a structural question
Reads source via get_code_snippet with a qualified name

evals.prompt: Find dead code and high fan-out functions in this repo.
evals.expected_output: Uses search_graph with max_degree=0 and exclude_entry_points for dead code.
assertions: Uses search_graph(max_degree=0, exclude_entry_points=true) for dead code
Uses graph quality queries for fan-out rather than manual file reading
Uses detect_changes for impact of local changes when asked

evals.prompt: Find every place the string 'TODO(lucas)' appears.
evals.expected_output: Plain text search; graph tools are not needed.
assertions: Uses Grep or search_code for the literal string
Does not build a call-graph trace
